serverInfo.description: 12 deterministic AI architecture cost-planning calculators: token counting, provider cost, self-host breakeven, context window fit, quantization, fine-tune ROI, eval cost, observability cost, RAG pipeline cost, agent loop cost, automation/iPaaS cost, and agent workflow orchestration cost.
